title: Contractivity of Multi-Stage Runge-Kutta Dynamics
summary: Many control, optimization, and learning algorithms rely on discretizations of continuous-time contracting systems, where preservation of contractivity under numerical integration is key for stability, robustness, and reliable fixed-point computation. In this paper, we establish conditions under which multi-stage Runge-Kutta methods preserve strong contractivity when discretizing infinitesimally contractive continuous-time systems.
